Complete API reference for all built-in PraisonAIUI feature protocol endpoints (48 default-enabled feature protocols across the core host, agent operations, and layout data, plus opt-in builtin.video). A running server describes every route it answers, plugins included, at GET /api/openapi.json, and the app shell's API Reference page lets you try them: see API Reference page and OpenAPI document.

Protocol-driven real-time agent chat (builtin.chat). See Gateway Chat. Method Endpoint Description POST /api/chat/send Send a chat message and stream or receive the reply GET /api/chat/context-stats Context window and token statistics for active sessions GET /api/chat/history/{session_id} Retrieve message history for a session POST /api/chat/abort Abort an in-progress reply WS /api/chat/ws Bidirectional chat WebSocket stream

Safe file uploads for chat and aiui.file_upload() (builtin.chat). See Attachments. Method Endpoint Description POST /api/chat/attachments Upload a file (multipart/form-data); returns safe metadata (UUID, filename, MIME, size) without server paths GET /api/chat/attachments/{session_id} List attachments uploaded for a session DELETE /api/chat/attachments/{attachment_id} Delete an attachment GET /api/chat/media/{attachment_id} Stream/download an uploaded attachment

Agent-driven interactive UI surfaces (builtin.canvas). See A2UI Canvas. Method Endpoint Description GET /api/surfaces List active surfaces GET /api/surfaces/capabilities Supported A2UI catalog capabilities GET /api/surfaces/{surface_id} Get current component tree and data model for a surface POST /api/surfaces/{surface_id}/messages Push A2UI surface update messages POST /api/surfaces/{surface_id}/action Dispatch a user action from a surface (alias: /api/surfaces/{surface_id}/actions) DELETE /api/surfaces/{surface_id} Remove a surface

Recorded agent run playback (builtin.replay). See Replay. Method Endpoint Description GET /api/replay/runs List recorded runs GET /api/replay/runs/{run_id}/events Fetch step-by-step events for a run GET /api/replay/runs/{run_id}/stream Stream live replay events (SSE) POST /api/replay/run Start a new recorded run

Multi-agent task board (builtin.work). See Work Hub & Kanban. Method Endpoint Description GET /api/kanban/board Columns and cards (?board=default&tenant=...&archived=false) GET /api/kanban/boards List available boards POST /api/kanban/tasks Create a task (201) POST /api/kanban/tasks/bulk Bulk move task_ids to a status GET / PATCH / DELETE /api/kanban/tasks/{task_id} Read, update, or delete a task POST /api/kanban/tasks/{task_id}/move Move a task to another column POST /api/kanban/tasks/{task_id}/comments Append a comment to a task GET /api/kanban/events SSE stream of board events GET /api/kanban/health Kanban store health and task counts

Subagent hierarchy and delegation tree (builtin.agents). See Subagent Tree. Method Endpoint Description GET /api/subagents List all recorded subagent runs GET /api/subagents/{session_id} Get subagent delegation tree for a session

Knowledge base and RAG store (builtin.knowledge). See Knowledge & Embeddings. Method Endpoint Description GET /api/knowledge List knowledge entries POST /api/knowledge Add a text entry POST /api/knowledge/search Semantic or keyword search POST /api/knowledge/add-file Upload and ingest a file GET /api/knowledge/status Backend status and entry count DELETE /api/knowledge Clear all entries GET / DELETE /api/knowledge/{entry_id} Fetch or delete a single entry

Execution node registry and presence (builtin.nodes). See Execution Nodes. Method Endpoint Description GET / POST /api/nodes List or register execution nodes GET / PUT / DELETE /api/nodes/{node_id} Read, update, or remove a node GET /api/nodes/{node_id}/status Node online status and last heartbeat GET / PUT /api/nodes/{node_id}/agents List or assign agents on a node GET /api/nodes/instances List connected instances (alias: GET /api/instances) POST /api/instances/heartbeat Report instance presence heartbeat

Model Context Protocol server registry (builtin.mcp) and editor setup (builtin.connect). See MCP and Connect. File watcher for live config reloads (builtin.config). See Config Hot-Reload. Method Endpoint Description GET /api/config/watcher Current watcher status and watched files POST /api/config/watcher/start Start watching config files POST /api/config/watcher/stop Stop watching config files POST /api/config/reload Force an immediate config reload

GET /api/training/sessions/{session_id} Full report, iterations, and best iteration POST /api/training/sessions/{session_id}/apply Apply training profile to agent_id
